Standard: High-level VCF architecture, including integration with supporting subsystems, provides the redundancy and functional separation to meet PLOC, failure immunity, fail-safe, and VCF safety-critical requirements established for the air vehicle. Separation and isolation exist between critical and non-critical functions to prevent propagation of failures. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Vehicle control function functional block diagram defines functional flow with underlying redundancy identified.
(2) Vehicle control function internal and external interfaces are defined.
(3) Vehicle control function component functional requirements are defined to include redundancy and functional separation. Analysis.
  (1) Safety-critical function thread analysis, or equivalent, identifies SCFs and functional flow.
  (2) Software architecture identifies separation between critical and non-critical functions.
